title: Negative Associations in Word Embeddings Predict anti-Black Bias Across Regions–but only via Name Frequency

bias_targets.methodology: Using the Word Embedding Association Test (WEAT) on region-specific word embeddings trained on geo-tagged Twitter data to compare the cosine similarity of African-American versus European-American names with pleasant and unpleasant attribute words, and correlating these linguistic bias estimates with regional survey and experimental measures of racial animus.
